shared_elements: carved stone monument with a tall vertical format
low-relief incised carving on a weathered stone surface
rectangular framed panels or cartouche-like compartments
justification: Both are tall, weathered stone monuments bearing shallow relief carving in which rounded elements sit inside rectangular framed compartments, and both use a similar vocabulary of curvilinear incised outlines. The decisive difference is compositional: A is dominated by a single large anthropomorphic figure with headdress and a chest disc filling the whole boulder, whereas B is an evenly ruled grid of repeated small square blocks with no overarching figure.
